name: html_entity_decode
description: Decode named HTML entities into the literal punctuation character. Matched controls copy the entity name without decoding.
generator_code:
import random,json,html
random.seed(0)
entities=['lt','gt','amp','quot','apos'];items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 name=entities[i%5];entity='&'+name+';';tag=random.choice(['div','span','p','code','title']);p=f'HTML fragment: <{tag}>{entity}</{tag}>\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Decode the entity. Write only its single literal character, not a code block. Answer:','answer':' '+html.unescape(entity)})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the entity name, omitting & and ;. Answer:','answer':' '+name})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
